source_tool: Closed-form expansion of r_n = √(n·λ·d1·d2/(d1+d2)), λ = c/f, c = 299792458 m/s (CODATA 2018, SI exact); evaluated at IEEE-754 double precision.
notes: Phase 2 of the RF audit will replace these with values regenerated from ITU-R P.526-15 §3 worked examples and an independent reference (e.g. Python `itur` or Ippolito §6).
Tolerance 1 mm is loose enough to accept either the closed-form constant 32.44778… presentation or a textbook-rounded Friis form; tight enough to flag any sign/factor errors.
